name: Get to Work Chicagoland 2023
information: Competitions in highly populated areas - like this one - tend to fill quickly, and do have limited spots. Please [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/register) as soon as you are able, in order to secure a spot in this competition. If you are on the [competitor list](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/registrations) and are no longer planning on competing in this competition, please cancel your registration. There will be competitors on the [waitist](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#28080-waitlist) who are wishing to take your place, and you wil recieve a refund if you cancel by the refund deadline. Please review the "[Competitor Responsibilities/Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#28078-competitor-responsibilities-info-must-read)" tab, and other tabs as necessary, before the competition. Please take note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change depending on whether this competition is running ahead of time, or behind on time. We are not responsible for no-shows if we begin an event early, and you miss your opprotunity to compete. We need to keep the competition moving along, so we recommend arriving 20-30 minutes before you are scheduled to compete/judge. We may also change the original schedule after competitors register for the competition based on registration numbers for each event, but we will not add or remove full events or change the order of events. At the end of the competition, please pick up any garbage left over and dispose it. This will allow the opportunity that we can use this venue again for more competitions in the future.
